external_sources.name: Evertse, On sums of S-units and linear recurrences, Compositio Mathematica 53 (1984), 225–244
external_sources.scope: Printed Corollary 1, page 227, inspected from the primary scan, including collective gcd one, nondegeneracy of all proper subsums, and the complete product of outside-S prime powers. Used for the new written asymptotic theorem; not locally formalized.

external_sources.name: Applegate and Lagarias, Lower Bounds for the Total Stopping Time of 3x+1 Iterates, arXiv:math/0103054
external_sources.scope: Definition 3.2, iterative proof of Theorem 3.1, Theorem 4.1 and Table 3 inspected. Published 14/29 inverse-path certificate sharpens sufficient ternary precision. Its 350,688,758-entry computation was not regenerated; the elementary every-cell theorem is independent of it.

external_sources.name: Weaver and fourier_wren, paper 48 v2
external_sources.scope: Named analytic input F. Lemma 7, equation (76), and bounded-branch proof of Theorem 8 inspected, retaining central totals, fixed ordinary targets, bounded real offset and linear extra ternary precision. No claim of complete independent verification of the analytic paper.

external_sources.name: Shaik, polylogarithmic Collatz trajectory paper v4.0.2 (2026-10-04)
external_sources.scope: Named analytic input H. Corollary 1.2 and the actual shortcut odd-count estimate in the time-control proof of Proposition 6.4 inspected. Endpoint equality alone is insufficient. External formalization archive was not rebuilt.

verification_boundary: Three new local Lean modules and four finite scripts were replayed at their recorded scope. F and H remain named analytic manuscript inputs. The late PR201 cover replay uses four isolated pinned files; no entire upstream branch or analytic formalization archive is claimed rebuilt.
